custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

English-Wizard.question: ১) What is the Indirect Speech of - Anis said, "I must write a letter?"
English-Wizard.option1: Anis said that he has to write a letter.
English-Wizard.option2: Anis said that he had to write a letter.
English-Wizard.option3: Anis said that he must write a letter.
English-Wizard.option4: Anis said that he wrote a letter.
English-Wizard.exp:
Direct narration থেকে Indirect narration এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম হলো-
- প্রথমে Reporting verb-এর Subject বসে এবং তারপর Reporting verb (say/said, tell/told) বসে (যদি থাকে)।
- তারপর যদি বাক্যটি assertive sentence হয়, তাহলে Inverted comma (" ") উঠিয়ে দিয়ে conjunction হিসেবে that বসানো হয়।
- এরপর Reported speech-এর person পরিবর্তন করতে হয়।
- Reporting verb-এর Subject বা Object-এর number (একবচন বা বহুবচন), person (first, second, third) এবং gender (male/female) অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন হয়।
- যখন Reported Verb past হয়, তখন must → had to হবে।
- তারপর বাক্যটির বাকি অংশ বসানো হয়।

Direct narration: Anis said, "I must write a letter."
Indirect narration: Anis said that he had to write a letter.

English-Wizard.question: ২) Nothing can stop us, _______?
English-Wizard.option1: can't it
English-Wizard.option2: can it
English-Wizard.option3: can they
English-Wizard.option4: can't they
English-Wizard.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর - Nothing can stop us, can it?

• Statement-এ Subject হিসেবে যদি,
- Everybody, everyone, somebody, someone, anybody, anyone, nobody, none থাকে, তাহলে tag করার সময় এদের Pronoun হিসেবে 'They' ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- Everything, something, anything, nothing থাকলে Pronoun হিসেবে It ব্যবহৃত হয়।
• এছাড়া কিছু negative word যেমন- none, nothing, hardly, seldom, scarcely ইত্যাদি Statement- এ ব্যবহৃত হলে Statement-টিকে Negative ধরে Positive tag ব্যবহার করতে হবে। 

যেমন-
- Everybody likes flowers, don't they?
- Nothing is impossible, is it?

English-Wizard.question:
৩) Choose the correct question tag:
Let's enjoy the party, ________?
English-Wizard.option1: won't we
English-Wizard.option2: shan't we
English-Wizard.option3: will you
English-Wizard.option4: shall we
English-Wizard.exp:
The correct question tag is: Let's enjoy the party, shall we?

- Positive statement-টি যদি মূল Verb দিয়ে শুরু হয় অথবা Let + Personal object দিয়ে শুরু হয় তাহলে Tag করার ক্ষেত্রে will you ব্যবহার করা যায়।
- কিন্তু Let us/Let's দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া বাক্যের ক্ষেত্রে 'Shall we' Tag question হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হবে।

যেমন-
- Let him complete the project, will you?
- Let's go to a picnic, shall we?

English-Wizard.question: ৪) Which one is the correct sentence?
English-Wizard.option1: He asked me if I had passed
English-Wizard.option2: He asked me if I passed
English-Wizard.option3: He asked me did I pass
English-Wizard.option4: He asked me if I have passed
English-Wizard.exp:
The correct sentence is 'He asked me if I had passed'.

- 'He asked me if I had passed' এটি একটি Indirect Speech.
- এর Direct speech: He said to me, 'Have you passed?'
- এখানে said-এর পরিবর্তে asked হয়েছে।
- Wh-question না থাকায় কমা উঠিয়ে if এবং Present perfect পরিবর্তিত হয়ে Past perfect হয়েছে Assertive আকারে।

Direct narration: He said to me, 'Have you passed?'
Indirect narration: He asked me if I had passed.

English-Wizard.question: ৫) There is a cat on the roof, _______?
English-Wizard.option1: is there
English-Wizard.option2: isn't it
English-Wizard.option3: is it
English-Wizard.option4: isn't there
English-Wizard.exp:
There is a cat on the roof, isn't there?

- Sentence-এর শুরুতে There is, There are, It is ইত্যাদি থাকলে এবং তা যদি Pseudo-subject-এর কাজ করে, তাহলে tag করার ক্ষেত্রে Subject pronoun হিসেবে There বা It ব্যবহৃত হয়।
-যেহেতু প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি affirmative এ আছে, তাই Tag question Negative হবে।

যেমন-
- There has not been a great response to the sale, has there?
-There is a cat on the roof, isn't there?

English-Wizard.question:
৬) Choose the correct narration-
Rimu said to her mother, "I shall go to bed now."
English-Wizard.option1: Rimu told her mother that she will go to bed now.
English-Wizard.option2: Rimu told her mother that she will go to bed then.
English-Wizard.option3: Rimu told her mother that she should go to bed now.
English-Wizard.option4: Rimu told her mother that she would go to bed then.
English-Wizard.exp:
Indirect speech-এর নিয়মানুযায়ী Direct speech থেকে Indirect করার সময়-
- প্রথমে Reporting verb-এর Subject বসে এবং তারপর Reporting verb (say/said, tell/told) বসে (যদি থাকে)।
- তারপর যদি বাক্যটি assertive sentence হয়, তাহলে Inverted comma (" ") উঠিয়ে দিয়ে conjunction হিসেবে that বসানো হয়।
- এরপর Reported speech-এর person পরিবর্তন করতে হয়।
- Reporting verb-এর Subject বা Object-এর number (একবচন বা বহুবচন), person (first, second, third) এবং gender (male/female) অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন হয়।
- Direct speech Shall/will থাকলে সেটি পরিবর্তিত হয়ে Would হয়।
- Now পরিবর্তিত হয়ে Then বসে।

Direct narration: Rimu said to her mother, "I shall go to bed now."
Indirect narration: Rimu told her mother that she would go to bed then.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) She doesn't like coffee,_______?
English-Wizard.option1: does she
English-Wizard.option2: doesn't she
English-Wizard.option3: isn't she
English-Wizard.option4: is she
English-Wizard.exp:
Negative বাক্যের tag question affirmative হবে আর tag question-এর structure হবে negative বাক্যের auxiliary verb + sub-এর subjective pronoun.

সুতরাং সঠিক tag question সম্পর্কিত বাক্যটি হবে- She doesn't like coffee, does she?

English-Wizard.question:
৮) Select the indirect form of speech:
My father said, "All that glitters is not gold."
English-Wizard.option1: My father advised that all that glitters is not gold.
English-Wizard.option2: My father remarked that all that glitters is not gold.
English-Wizard.option3: My father said that all that glitters was not gold.
English-Wizard.option4: My father said that all that glitters is not gold.
English-Wizard.exp:
- Universal truth বা habitual fact প্রকাশ করায় বাক্যটির indirect narration গঠনের সময় verb-এর রূপ পরিবর্তন হবে না।

Direct narration: My father said, "All that glitters is not gold."
Indirect narration: My father said that all that glitters is not gold.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) "It's been a long time since you've seen him," ________?
English-Wizard.option1: hasn't it?
English-Wizard.option2: isn't it?
English-Wizard.option3: hasn't him?
English-Wizard.option4: haven't it?
English-Wizard.exp:
Subject 'it' এবং 'verb' present perfect tense হলে,
'tag', question অংশে 'has' এর Negative form 'hasn't' এবং 'it' Pronoun-টি ব্যবহৃত হবে।

সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তরটি হবে,
It's been a long time since you've seen him, hasn't it?

English-Wizard.question:
১০) Choose the correct narration-
"Don't waste time", the teacher said to the students.
English-Wizard.option1: The teacher advised the students not to waste time.
English-Wizard.option2: The teacher advised the students to not waste time.
English-Wizard.option3: The teacher forbade the students not to waste time.
English-Wizard.option4: The teacher ordered the students don't waste time.
English-Wizard.exp:
Imperative sentence-কে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তর করার ক্ষেত্রে,
- প্রদত্ত Direct speech এ অনুরোধ বুঝালে request বসবে, আদেশ বুঝালে command/order বসবে, উপদেশ বুঝালে advise বসবে।
- অন্যথায় tell দ্বারা পরিবর্তিত হবে।
- সেই সাথে comma উঠে গিয়ে to বসবে।

Direct narration: "Don't waste time", the teacher said to the students.
Indirect narration: The teacher advised the students not to waste time.

English-Wizard.question:
১১) Choose the correct tag question for the sentence:
"I'm late," _______?
English-Wizard.option1: am I
English-Wizard.option2: aren't I
English-Wizard.option3: isn't I
English-Wizard.option4: am not I
English-Wizard.exp:
Correct Ans - খ) aren't I.

- Positive statement- এর Subject  হিসেবে I এবং Verb হিসেবে am থাকলে, Tag করার ক্ষেত্রে aren't অথবা ain't ব্যবহার করা হয়।
- Affirmative statement এর ক্ষেত্রে tag question হয় auxiliary verb এর negetive form (সংক্ষিপ্ত) + Subject (pronoun).

সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর- I'm late, aren't I

English-Wizard.question: ১২) Choose the appropriate tag of- Don't make a noise, ________?
English-Wizard.option1: will you?
English-Wizard.option2: isn't it?
English-Wizard.option3: shan't you?
English-Wizard.option4: do you?
English-Wizard.exp:
- Imperative sentence-এর Tag Question- will you বা won't you হয়।
- Tag sentence Neg. হলে will you আর affirmative হলে won't you হবে।

সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর Don't make a noise, will you?

English-Wizard.question:
১৩) Choose the correct indirect speech:
Raju said, "Good morning, my friends."
English-Wizard.option1: Raju say good morning to his friends.
English-Wizard.option2: Raju said good morning to his friends.
English-Wizard.option3: Raju wished his friends good morning.
English-Wizard.option4: Raju told his friends good morning.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Indirect speech-এর নিয়মানুযায়ী Direct speech থেকে Indirect করার সময়-
- বাক্যে good morning/evening থাকলে say-এর পরিবর্তে wish এবং good-bye/ good night থাকলে say-এর পরিবর্তে bade বসে। 
- এরপর Reported speech-এর person পরিবর্তন করতে হয়।
- Reporting verb-এর Subject বা Object-এর number (একবচন বা বহুবচন), person (first, second, third) এবং gender (male/female) অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন হয়।
- Wish দিয়ে শুভকামনা জানানো হলে এবং Object (যাকে শুভেচ্ছা দেওয়া হচ্ছে) থাকলে, তখন Object এর আগে to বসে।

Direct narration: Raju said, "Good morning, my friends."
Indirect narration: Raju wished his friends good morning.
0r, Raju wished good morning to his friends.

English-Wizard.question:
১৪) Choose the correct tag question for the sentence:
Don't let him boss you about, ________?
English-Wizard.option1: are you
English-Wizard.option2: will you
English-Wizard.option3: shall you
English-Wizard.option4: None
English-Wizard.exp:
- Imperative sentence-এর Tag Question- will you বা won't you হয়।
- Tag sentence Neg. হলে will you আর affirmative হলে won't you হবে।

উত্তর গ- will you হবে।
সঠিক উত্তর-  Don't let him boss you about, will you?

English-Wizard.question:
১৫) Choose the correct indirect speech:
He said, "Hurrah! We have won the game."
English-Wizard.option1: He exclaimed with sorrow that they had won the game.
English-Wizard.option2: He exclaimed with joy that they had won the game.
English-Wizard.option3: He exclaimed with joy that they won the game.
English-Wizard.option4: He cried out of joy that they had won the game.
English-Wizard.exp:
Exclamatory Sentence-এর Narration:
- Say-এর পরিবর্তে আনন্দ বোঝালে exclaim in/with joy/delight/wonder, cry out in joy ইত্যাদি বসে।
- আর দুঃখ বোঝালে exclaim with sorrow/grief ইত্যাদি বসে।
- কমা উঠিয়ে that বসে।
- Alas, ah, hurrah, etc. থাকলে তা বাদ দিয়ে বাক্যটিকে Assertive করতে হয়।

Direct narration: He said, "Hurrah! We have won the game."
Indirect narration: He exclaimed with joy that they had won the game.

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) The girl said, "No, I denied stealing the money."
English-Wizard.option1: The girl said that she denied to steal the money.
English-Wizard.option2: The girl told that she has denied stealing the money.
English-Wizard.option3: The girl said that she stole the money.
English-Wizard.option4: The girl emphatically denied stealing the money.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Indirect speech-এর নিয়মানুযায়ী Direct speech থেকে Indirect করার সময়-
- প্রথমে Reporting verb-এর Subject বসে এবং তারপর Reporting verb (say/said, tell/told) বসে (যদি থাকে)।
- তারপর যদি বাক্যটি assertive sentence হয়, তাহলে Inverted comma (" ") উঠিয়ে দিয়ে conjunction হিসেবে that বসানো হয়।
- এরপর Reported speech-এর person পরিবর্তন করতে হয়।
- Reporting verb-এর Subject বা Object-এর number (একবচন বা বহুবচন), person (first, second, third) এবং gender (male/female) অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন হয়।

- 'জোড়ালোভাবে প্রত্যাখ্যান' বোঝাতে Indirect Narration এ 'deny' verb' এর পূর্বে 'emphatically' adverb-টি ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Direct narration: The girl said, "No, I denied stealing the money."
Indirect narration: The girl emphatically denied stealing the money.

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) He has to work hard to get a higher salary, ________?
English-Wizard.option1: does he
English-Wizard.option2: doesn't he
English-Wizard.option3: hasn't he
English-Wizard.option4: has he
English-Wizard.exp:
'Has to/have to' modal-টি Present Indefinite- এর auxiliary হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয় না। এ ক্ষেত্রে do/does হয়।
প্রশ্নোক্ত বাক্যের tag question হবে- doesn't he.

He has to work hard to get a higher salary, doesn't he?

English-Wizard.question:
১৮) Change the narration-
She said to me, "Where do you live?"
English-Wizard.option1: She asked me where did I live.
English-Wizard.option2: She asked me where do I live.
English-Wizard.option3: She asked me where I lived.
English-Wizard.option4: She said me where I lived.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Interrogative Sentence-এর Narration :
- Reporting verb said to-এর পরিবর্তে asked বসে।
- প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যটিতে Wh-question word আছে তাহলে comma উঠে বরং where অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।
- Reporting verb-এর Object অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তিত হয়ে you → I হবে।
- Indirect Speech-এ Tense পরিবর্তিত হয়ে Past Simple হয়।

Direct narration: She said to me, "Where do you live?"
Indirect narration: She asked me where I lived.

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) You said to me, "Why were you absent?"
English-Wizard.option1: You told me why I had been absent.
English-Wizard.option2: You asked me why had I been absent.
English-Wizard.option3: You told me why had I been absent.
English-Wizard.option4: You asked me why I had been absent.
English-Wizard.exp:
- Direct sentence-এর reported speech interrogative হলে indirect করার সময় তাকে affirmative করতে হয়।
- Direct speech-এ past tense (were) থাকলে Indirect Speech-এ past perfect tense (had been) ব্যবহার করা হয়।

Direct narration: You said to me, "Why were you absent?"
Indirect narration: You asked me why I had been absent.

English-Wizard.question:
২০) Choose the correct indirect speech:
Rahim said, "Good evening, will you come with me?"
English-Wizard.option1: Rahim wished him good evening and requested to come with him.
English-Wizard.option2: Rahim wished him good evening and asked if he would come with him.
English-Wizard.option3: Rahim wished him good evening and asked if he will come with him.
English-Wizard.option4: Rahim wished him good evening and told him he will come with him.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Indirect speech-এর নিয়মানুযায়ী Direct speech থেকে Indirect করার সময়-
- বাক্যে good morning/evening থাকলে say-এর পরিবর্তে wish এবং good-bye/ good night থাকলে say-এর পরিবর্তে bade বসে। 
- এরপর Reported speech-এর person পরিবর্তন করতে হয়।
- Reporting verb-এর Subject বা Object-এর number (একবচন বা বহুবচন), person (first, second, third) এবং gender (male/female) অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন হয়।

- Reported speech-এ good morning/good evening এবং interrogative বাক্য থাকলে structure হবে-
- sub+ wished + someone + good evening + and + asked + whether/if+ sub+will এর past form would+ প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যের sub-এর বাকি অংশ।

Direct narration: Rahim said, 'Good evening, will you come with me?'
Indirect narration: Rahim wished him good evening and asked if he would come with him.
